title: Hashima HP-450MS
subtitle: Compact Fusing Press

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Hashima HP-450MS is a compact continuous-type fusing press designed for small-to-medium fusing operations on shirt collars, cuffs, plackets, and similar garment components. With a 450 mm fusing belt width and 220–230V single-phase power, it fits in smaller workshops and sample rooms where a 3-phase industrial press is impractical.
applications: Fusing interlining onto shirt collars, cuffs, and plackets in small workshops
Any operation requiring single-phase 220–230V power instead of 3-phase 380V
purposeAndApplication.industry: Small-batch shirt production, sample rooms, garment workshops, trouser and jeans production

overviewDescription: The Hashima HP-450MS is a compact fusing press from the Hashima HP series. It runs on single-phase 220–230V power with a 4 kW heater and ~33 W motor. The fusing belt width is 450 mm, max temperature 195 °C, max pressure 1.5 kg/cm², and max belt speed 8.7 m/min, with heating times from 5 to 20 seconds. Features include automatic belt-warping prevention (direct limit-switch type, upper & lower), rubber non-slip driving rollers, a one-side-open front body that fits any fabric size, and a standard rotary strip-off device (MS model).
finalNotes:
• The HP-450MS is the compact / single-phase counterpart to the larger HP-900LFS — ideal when 3-phase 380V power is unavailable.
• The MS suffix = Mechanical / Manual Strip-off (rotary type, standard) — different from the LFS variant which is the larger 900 mm linear fusing press.
